title: By the Balls Stills
eyebrow: BadCode Shorts · By the Balls · stills round 1
heading: By the Balls: stills, round 1
intro: A young couple of millennials feed an arcade claw machine; the claw grabs the little house and goes limp. BadCode: "It was never broken. It was set." Then everyone turns the land-price dial together and the claw holds. Every still follows a real Unsplash photo's layout; prompts by a sealed writer; pollution check clean. Pick one per shot and leave a note.

sections.lede: Claude's picks are marked; problems are flagged on the still.
